description: This Java class 'PackingServices' provides service methods for managing packing operations within the OFBiz framework, including adding lines to a packing session, bulk packing, package sequence management, and calculating shipping charges.

classes.name: PackingServices
classes.description: A utility class providing static service methods for managing packing sessions, package lines, and shipping calculations within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: addPackLine
methods.description: Adds or increases a line item in the packing session with specified product, quantity, weight, and instructions.

methods.name: packBulk
methods.description: Creates or updates multiple package lines based on selected items, handling multiple packages, quantities, and weights.

methods.name: incrementPackageSeq
methods.description: Returns the next available package sequence number.

methods.name: clearLastPackage
methods.description: Clears the last package and returns the next package sequence number.

methods.name: clearPackLine
methods.description: Removes a specific line from the packing session based on identifiers.

methods.name: clearPackAll
methods.description: Clears all packing lines from the session.

methods.name: calcPackSessionAdditionalShippingCharge
methods.description: Calculates and sets additional shipping charges based on package weights and shipping details.

methods.name: completePack
methods.description: Finalizes the packing session, setting instructions, shipping info, and completing the shipment process.

methods.name: setSessionPackageWeights
methods.description: Sets weights for packages in the session and calculates total shippable weight.

methods.name: setSessionShipmentBoxTypes
methods.description: Sets box types for packages in the session.
